model_intro: Cleared's sessions run Claude Code on your Claude subscription. Run the command below, open the address it shows, sign in, and paste what it prints into the field.
model_terminal_open: Open a terminal to run it
model_terminal_note: The terminal runs in a throwaway container with nothing of this machine in it. Nothing you type there is kept, and the container is removed when the terminal closes.
model_terminal_elsewhere: Or run it on any computer where Claude Code is installed.
model_ok: Claude Code is connected. Sessions will use this login.
model_set: A login is saved, since {date}. It is never shown again.
model_set_undated: A login is saved. It is never shown again.
model_set_environment: The login comes from the file the CLEARED_CLAUDE_CREDENTIALS variable of Cleared's environment names. Change it there.
model_api: An Anthropic API key is not offered: Cleared's Claude Code sessions use a subscription's login.
model_error_invalid: This is not what claude setup-token prints. Its line starts with sk-ant-oat.
model_error_environment: The login comes from Cleared's environment: change it there.
model_error_other: The login could not be saved. Try again in a moment.
terminal_mode_shell: A shell in a throwaway container
terminal_mode_harness: A shell in a throwaway container
terminal_mode_unsupported: A shell in a throwaway container
terminal_input_failed: A key did not reach the terminal. Type it again.
terminal_closed_exit: The shell ended. The container is removed.
terminal_closed_exit_harness: The shell ended. The container is removed.
terminal_closed_idle: Closed after 15 min without a key.
terminal_closed_refused: The terminal could not start: Docker or the session image may be missing on this machine.
